evidence_boundaries: The capture yield is directly measured at CSNS Back-n; PHWT, double-bunch unfolding, background scaling and SAMMY resonance fitting are model-assisted analysis stages.
The reported capture cross section uses ENDF/B-VIII.1 total cross section, so it is not a fully independent absolute cross-section measurement.
The MACS above 300 keV uses ENDF/B-VIII.1; the evaluated contribution reaches 10.8 percent at kT=100 keV.
This is not a laser-driven neutron experiment and does not validate a laser target, source spectrum, EMP environment or shot-to-shot stability.
No raw waveform replay, unfolding, PHWT or GEANT4 response simulation, SAMMY fit or MACS recalculation was performed locally.
